author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitch Spence optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Royals optioned RHP Mitch Spence to Triple-A Omaha.
impact: Spence was just called back up on Monday. He'll head back to Triple-A to make room for Connor Seabold.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Seth Lugo (concussion) continuing throwing progression
desc: Seth Lugo has continued to take part in a throwing progression while on the concussion injured list.
impact: Lugo had a CT scan come back clean after he was hit by a comebacker. It is possible he misses the minimum amount of time on the injured list given that he wasn't shut down from throwing.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Rengifo designated for assignment
desc: The Brewers are designating Luis Rengifo for assignment.
impact: Milwaukee needed to open a spot on its 40-man roster for top prospect infielder Cooper Pratt. Rengifo will head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jasson Dominguez has tooth pulled, status uncertain Tuesday
desc: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Jasson Dominguez had a tooth pulled on Tuesday.
impact: It is unclear if Dominguez will be in the lineup on Tuesday. He is day-to-day for now.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trent Grisham (hamstring) expected to miss a few weeks
desc: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said he expects Trent Grisham to be out "a few weeks" with his right hamstring injury.
impact: Grisham was placed on the 10-day injured list Saturday. He will be sidelined into July.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Isaac Paredes goes yard in loss to Tigers
desc: Isaac Paredes went 1-for-1 in Monday's 9-3 loss to the Tigers with a two-run home run and three walks.
impact: Paredes has provided mixed results at the plate of late, collecting hits in six of his last 12 games. The veteran continues to fight lapses in consistency at the plate for manager Joe Espada, batting .232 with 10 homers, 35 RBI, and 29 runs scored through 67 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jose Altuve goes deep in loss to Tigers
desc: Jose Altuve went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Tigers with a solo home run.
impact: Altuve has offered mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in five of his last nine contests. The veteran remains one of many inconsistent options in the Astros lineup, slashing .238 with seven homers, 16 RBI, 32 runs scored, and one stolen base through 51 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sebastian Walcott (elbow) continuing rehab progression
desc: Rangers' top prospect Sebastian Walcott is in Arlington this week to continue some of his rehab progression.
impact: Walcott is expected to return this season after getting an internal brace and not the full Tommy John surgery. He could return as early as late July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ricky Tiedemann (elbow) to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Ricky Tiedemann will begin a rehab assignment in the Florida Complex League on Tuesday.
impact: Tiedemann missed all of the 2025 season after undergoing Tommy John surgery. It is unclear what role he might play later this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: DJ Herz (elbow) to continue rehab assignment with Single-A Fredericksburg
desc: DJ Herz will continue his rehab assignment with Single-A Fredericksburg on Tuesday.
impact: Herz is continuing to work his way back from Tommy John surgery from last April. He'll continue a lengthy rehab assignment.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kai-Wei Teng tagged early in loss to Tigers
desc: Kai-Wei Teng allowed five earned runs on six hits and two walks while striking out nine over 3 1/3 innings in Monday's loss to the Tigers.
impact: Teng has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in each of his last four starts. The right-hander has been much more stable out of the bullpen instead of as a starting option for manager Joe Espada, posting a 4.31 ERA and 1.34 WHIP with a 3-6 record and 9.7 K/9 ratio across 21 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: J.T. Ginn cruises through six in win over Pirates
desc: J.T. Ginn allowed one unearned run on six hits and two walks while striking out three over six innings in Monday's win over the Pirates.
impact: Ginn continues a strong stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in seven of his last eight trips to the mound. The right-hander has offered manager Mark Kotsay one of the more stable options as part of an underperforming Athletics rotation, posting a 2.91 ERA and 1.16 WHIP to go with a 5-3 record and 7.9 K/9 ratio across 16 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jeff McNeil drives in four in rout of Pirates
desc: Jeff McNeil went 3-for-4 in a win over the Pirates with a home run, three runs scored, and four RBI.
impact: McNeil has struggled at the plate of late, picking up hits in three of his last 10 contests. The veteran remains one of the more underwhelming options in the Athletics lineup for manager Mark Kotsay, batting .238 with three home runs, 19 RBI, 19 runs scored, and one stolen base across 65 games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Andrew Alvarez limits damage in four innings vs. Royals
desc: Andrew Alvarez allowed one earned run on five hits and one walk while striking out five over four innings in Monday's win over the Royals.
impact: Alvarez now has a 3.49 ERA and 1.45 WHIP with a 1-0 record through three starts. He is currently slated to make his next start on the road against Tampa Bay.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Dylan Crews Goes Yard, Drives In Three in 7-3 Win
desc: Dylan Crews provided some much-needed thump as Washington handled Kansas City.
impact: Crews went 1-for-4 in the win over the Royals with a home run, one run scored and three RBI. After Monday's win over Kansas City, Crews is slashing .195/.239/.356 through 23 games with four homers, 13 RBI, 11 runs scored and two stolen bases.
